# `db/queries/users.ts`

This module provides a set of async query functions for managing user records in the database. It handles user creation and lookup via Entra OID (supporting login-time upserts), as well as reading and updating per-user settings such as daily budget and maximum concurrent tasks.

---

## Exports

### `findOrCreateByEntraOid`

Finds an existing user by their Entra OID, or creates a new one. Uses an upsert (`INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE`) so that `email` and `displayName` stay current when the user logs in again.

```ts
import { findOrCreateByEntraOid } from '...'
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `oid` | `string` | The user's Entra Object ID. |
| `email` | `string` | The user's email address. |
| `displayName` | `string` | The user's display name. |

#### Returns

`Promise<{ id: number; entraOid: string; email: string; displayName: string; role: string; dailyBudget: string | null; maxConcurrent: number | null; createdAt: Date | null; updatedAt: Date | null; }>`

The full user record after the upsert operation.

#### Example

```ts
const user = await findOrCreateByEntraOid(
  'oid-abc-123',
  'jane@example.com',
  'Jane Doe'
)
console.log(user.id, user.role)
```

### `listAll`

Returns all users with their `id` and `displayName`, intended for general display purposes.

```ts
import { listAll } from '...'
```

#### Parameters

None.

#### Returns

`Promise<{ id: number; displayName: string; }[]>`

An array of objects containing each user's `id` and `displayName`.

#### Example

```ts
const users = await listAll()
users.forEach(u => console.log(u.id, u.displayName))
```

---

### `listAllWithRole`

Returns all users including role and per-user limit fields. Intended for use on an admin permissions page.

```ts
import { listAllWithRole } from '...'
```

#### Parameters

None.

#### Returns

`Promise<{ id: number; displayName: string; role: string; dailyBudget: string | null; maxConcurrent: number | null; }[]>`

An array of objects containing each user's `id`, `displayName`, `role`, `dailyBudget`, and `maxConcurrent`.

#### Example

```ts
const users = await listAllWithRole()
users.forEach(u => console.log(u.displayName, u.role, u.dailyBudget))
```

### `updateDailyBudget`

Updates the daily budget for a specific user.

```ts
import { updateDailyBudget } from '...'
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `userId` | `number` | The ID of the user to update. |
| `budget` | `string` | The new daily budget value. |

#### Returns

`Promise<void>`

#### Example

```ts
await updateDailyBudget(42, '100.00')
```

---

### `updateMaxConcurrent`

Updates the maximum number of concurrent tasks allowed for a specific user. Pass `null` to clear the per-user override and revert to the global default.

```ts
import { updateMaxConcurrent } from '...'
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `userId` | `number` | The ID of the user to update. |
| `value` | `number \| null` | The new max concurrent value, or `null` to revert to the global default. |

#### Returns

`Promise<void>`

#### Example

```ts
// Set a per-user limit
await updateMaxConcurrent(42, 5)

// Clear the override and revert to global default
await updateMaxConcurrent(42, null)
```

---

### `getMaxConcurrent`

Returns the `max_concurrent` value for a single user, or `null` if the user is using the global default.

```ts
import { getMaxConcurrent } from '...'
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `userId` | `number` | The ID of the user to query. |

#### Returns

`Promise<number | null>`

The user's max concurrent task limit, or `null` if no per-user override is set.

#### Example

```ts
const limit = await getMaxConcurrent(42)
if (limit === null) {
  console.log('Using global default')
} else {
  console.log(`User limit: ${limit}`)
}
```
